name: expense-tracker-root
description: Enterprise-grade Personal Finance and Expense Tracker platform root workspace

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npx --prefix backend tsc --project backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx --prefix frontend tsc --project frontend/tsconfig.json --noEmit

author: Antigravity Devs
